approachQuestion.prompt: Find the largest absolute difference between adjacent readings.
constraints: The input order must remain unchanged.

options.text: Scan each adjacent pair and keep the largest difference.
Store every adjacent difference, then find the maximum.
options.feedback: The correct pairs are compared, but the stored list is unnecessary.

options.text: Sort the readings, then compare adjacent values.
options.feedback: Sorting changes which readings were adjacent.

feedback.reason: Choose a method that respects the original order.

complexityQuestion.prompt: Choose the time and additional-space pair for the single-pass method.

options.text: O(n log n) time, O(n) additional space

feedback.reason: The pass reads each neighbor pair once and retains constant state.

methodReveal.title: One running maximum
methodReveal.description: Compare each adjacent pair and update the best difference as you move across the input.
